title: Magento Pricing
notes: Magento Open Source license is free (high confidence). Adobe Commerce is quote-only / GMV-tiered; public Adobe pages do not publish a fixed monthly tile. Industry partner ranges (2026) often cite ~$22k–$125k+/year on-prem depending on GMV, with Cloud higher — treat as medium confidence estimates, not Adobe-published floors. Hosting, agency, and extensions dominate TCO. Affiliate economics excluded.
